H1-P3.y: And the money side should go in stages too: don't try to fly straight to the economic destination! Only once the group can reliably provide for everybody, and fairly decide who gets what from the common, should it move to a common purse. And cutting back on outside money, or getting rid of it? That should come from what the group has shown it can do, rather than from deciding that "money is impure!" (which sounds weird while somebody else is quietly paying the tax bill).
